text: At its meeting held on June 8 and 9, City Council reappointed the following candidate to the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board for a term of office from June 10, 2021 to November 14, 2022: Jonathan Ahee City Council also appointed the following candidate to the Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board for a term of office from June 10, 2021 to November 14, 2022: Marcia Douglas This new appointment fills the position previously held by Warren Ross who resigned in May 2021.
The Film, Television and Digital Media Advisory Board received the item for information.
